newsitem.title: INDIA: India ACC sets AGM for September 3.
newsitem.headline: India ACC sets AGM for September 3.

text.p: India's largest cement-maker, the Associated Cement Companies (ACC), said on Wednesday that it would hold an annual general meeting of shareholders on September 3.
"It has accordingly been decided to close the register of members and share transfer books of the company from Friday, August 8, to Wednesday, September 3," the firm said in a statement.
ACC on Wednesday announced financial results for 1996/97 (April-March), declaring a net profit of 769.2 million rupees, down from 2.27 billion the previous year.
